event.distribution_pattern: Distributed to retail markets in Northern California.

products.product_description: Santos Brand, Bulgar Wheat, flour packed in clear plastic bags, 2 lbs.
products.code_info: There is no UPC code/lot code/expiration date on products.
products.reason_for_recall: The recall was initiated after it was discovered during a routine inspection that the products i.e. various kinds of flours, legumes and spices were cross packaged on shared equipment with peanuts and wheat flour. The products i.e. various kinds of flours, legumes and spices were distributed in packaging that did not reveal the presence of peanuts or wheat, but may contain traces of it.
